integrity: All-time sign conclusions follow from exact Fourier inversion and a one-critical-point proof; high-precision matrix exponentials and symbolic assertions are supporting verification, not exhaustive numerical proof. Earlier qualitative eventual-positivity results are acknowledged. Historical priority remains subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: No classification for larger periodic meshes, variable diffusivity, nonperiodic closures, or time-discretization schemes.
The threshold is in units of mesh spacing squared divided by diffusivity.
The sharp finite threshold is not a claim about the infinite-lattice heat kernel.
scientific_scope: Exact semidiscrete matrix exponential for the classical fourth-order five-point central difference Laplacian on exactly five equally spaced periodic nodes, all nonnegative real times.
title: Sharp eventual positivity on the first resolved fourth-order periodic heat grid
